codeReview.summary: The change resolves collisions between '.', '/', and space and adds broad tests, but the encoding is still not collision-safe overall because marker substrings and stripped characters can map distinct task names to the same tmux session name.

issues.description: The replacement strategy uses literal tokens ('_s_', '_d_', '_w_') without escaping existing marker-like input, so distinct task names collide (for example, 'my/task' and 'my_s_task' both map to 'wagner_my_s_task'). This violates the collision-safe requirement.

The final filter strips unsupported characters instead of encoding them, introducing additional collisions (for example, 'hello@world' and 'helloworld' both become 'wagner_helloworld'). This is not collision-safe encoding.
